content.text: Digital creators in Nigeria often find themselves locked out of Stripe and PayPal, unable to collect payments from their customers. What Each Option Actually Offers

When it comes to selling courses from Pakistan without Stripe, digital creators have a few options. Gumroad, for example, offers a platform for creators to sell their digital products, including courses. However, it comes with a 3.5% + 30¢ per sale transaction fee, which can add up quickly. Lemon Squeezy takes a 1% + 10¢ per sale fee, but also has a monthly minimum payment threshold of $100. In contrast, Paddle charges a 5% + 30¢ per sale fee, but offers a more comprehensive platform with features like analytics and customer support. Meanwhile, NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee for all cryptocurrencies, with no monthly minimum payments required.

When it comes to restricted countries, each option has its own set of limitations. Gumroad, for example, restricts sales to certain countries, including Pakistan. Lemon Squeezy also has a list of restricted countries, including Nigeria, where you cannot sell your courses. Paddle, on the other hand, has a more nuanced approach, allowing sales to certain countries, but also requiring additional verification for high-risk merchants. NOWPayments, on the other hand, has no restrictions on countries, allowing creators to sell their courses to anyone, anywhere.

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, each option has its own strengths and weaknesses. Paddle's 5% + 30¢ per sale fee may seem steep, but the comprehensive platform and customer support may be worth it for larger creators. NOWPayments' flat 0.5% fee, on the other hand, offers a low-cost option for creators who want to keep more of their revenue.

Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, each option has its own approach. Gumroad requires creators to give up ownership of their customer data, whereas NOWPayments allows creators to retain full ownership. Automation is also an issue, with Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy requiring manual intervention for certain tasks. Paddle, on the other hand, offers more comprehensive automation features, but at a cost. NOWPayments, meanwhile, allows creators to automate delivery and payment processing with ease, without sacrificing ownership or control.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

So, which architecture should you choose based on your situation? If you're looking for a low-cost option with fast payment processing, Gumroad may be the way to go.
